newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: SOCCER-HUNGARY CRUISE TO VICTORY IN AZERBAIJAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HUNGARY CRUISE TO VICTORY IN AZERBAIJAN.

text.p: Two goals from Ferencvaros midfielder Elek Nyilas helped Hungary cruise to a 3-0 victory over Azerbaijan in their Group three World Cup qualifier in Baku on Sunday.
The visitors dominated the first half, with Belgian-based midfielder Florian Urban dictating play in midfield.
In the 43rd minute Nyilas cut in from the right and drove a powerful, 16-metre shot past Azeri goalkeeper Zidkov to open the scoring.
In the second period Hungary extended their lead when Urban was brought down and Nyilas converted the penalty on 67 minutes.
The impressive Urban made sure of Hungary's second Group 3 victory with a goal from close-range on 78 minutes.
